00.name: Sweat
00.text: I can't believe you decided to go left. And here I thought you were smart.

01.name: Sour
01.text: The lumberer may not be smart but anyone who agrees with me is automatically cool.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: Being cool doesn't matter when your lost.

04.name: Narrator
04.text: The group was now lost. Use the 'wsd' or 'Up', 'Down' and 'Right' arrow keys in time with the beat to find your way out of the forest.
